reviews.reason: The one binding effect initializes an editable draft from async backend binding/default/plugin-tool data only while dirty is false. User edits set dirty and the draft together; once dirty, refreshed catalogue/binding data cannot overwrite unsaved settings. There is no chain of effects depending on each other setters. Binding tests cover reopened persisted values, application changes retaining toggles, missing declarations and rejected save draft retention. P21b reassessed 2026-11-17: CommunicationBindingForm replaces command_settings with canonical typed commands and adds event command editing/save failure handling; async binding initialization still stops once dirty, while the parent validates and saves through the supported forwardRef/useImperativeHandle contract after instance persistence. Tests assert canonical registered/event payloads, retained dirty input, reopen/edit/delete, reserved-name validation and read-only permissions. Management tests now read authorized file metadata/preview directly; this real query migration invalidates the old mutation rationale, which stays held. History navigation reset/empty ReactNode slots and standalone empty-status marker remain unchanged.

React 19 still supports forwardRef; this typed form exposes validate/save via useImperativeHandle to the parent channel drawer, which persists the instance before saving its binding. Replacing forwardRef with a ref prop is an optional representation change, not a repair to the imperative protocol. The parent validates and awaits the same handle, and binding tests cover its canonical saved fields. resetSelection is a tiny page/conversation reset patch spread into navigateCommunication calls in event handlers. Its object identity is never passed to a memoized child, dependency array, query key or external subscription. Moving it to module scope cannot remove the claimed child redraw; URL restoration and page/filter preservation tests cover the resulting navigation. CommunicationFile uses useMutation as an explicitly clicked access-link request: getCommunicationFile is a GET returning a temporary download URL, not a write to a cached entity. The result is consumed from link.data and errors are rendered locally. Invalidating message/conversation lists would not update a modified record because this request modifies none.
